Karnataka Minister Seeks Murder Charges for Fake Medicine Makers

Karnataka Health Minister U.T. Khader has called for stringent action against manufacturers of spurious medicines, stating they should face murder charges. He made this demand following reports of fake medicines being circulated. The minister emphasized the severe harm these counterfeit drugs can cause to public health.
